Description:
What motivates you? Is it power? Money? Respect? Or perhaps an insatiable craving for more, an unquenchable thirst that drives you relentlessly forward? Your race has built towering empires, conquered nations, and endured catastrophic collapses. Humans, embodying the duality of their nature, have proven themselves to be both the paragons of leadership and the epitomes of tyranny.
For every human, there exists an inherent aspiration for more. They yearn to leave the familiar confines of their towns and embark on grand adventures, driven by a potent mixture of thrill-seeking and the allure of promised rewards. No mountain stands too tall, no ocean runs too deep, and no desert presents an insurmountable challenge to these innate explorers. Humans possess an innate ability to multitask, deftly juggling myriad responsibilities, and they possess a sharp acumen for swiftly and efficiently solving problems.
The origin of the humans remains shrouded in mystery. Among the younger races, they burst forth seemingly out of nowhere, establishing themselves as a force to be reckoned with. Humans make formidable allies when befriended, their adaptability and resourcefulness shining through. However, one must exercise caution, for their unpredictable nature can transform them into formidable adversaries when antagonized. The humans, a complex and ever-evolving race, carry within them the potential for greatness or darkness, and their story continues to unfold across the realms, leaving an indelible mark wherever they tread.
Language: You speak Common and a number of chosen languages equal to your Focus or Presence (whichever is higher).

~Jack of all Trades~.Effect: You gain +1 in your lowest Stat and +2 Skill Points.

Starting Abilities Description.Humans:
Humans are among the most consistent of the races and their concentration and mental resilience make them able to constantly succeed at menial tasks.
Most humans are average in multiple domains, and skilled in a variety of different tasks.

Combat Extras: You swim at normal Movement Speed
~Tideborn~.Effect:
You can swim at your normal Movement Speed.
You have +1 in Swimming, Boating and Fishing.

Combat Extras: You have an extra Level 1 Talent
~Blue Blood~.Effect: You can pick _one extra_ Level 1 Utility or Class Talent.
~Blue Blood~.Downside: Your Max Health decreases by 2 and you have -2 in Survival.

~Hunter-Gatherer~.Effect:
Whenever you and your party defeats a boss, all Heroes in the party gain +1 Skill Point. You get 1 extra Skill Point.
You have +1 in Gathering and +1 in Hunting.

~Pigmy~.Effect:
Distract an enemy so that it won't attack you with its next attack.
At the end of this Combat, you gain +10% of all the {{Gold}Gold}{Gold}Gold and {{Gold}Gold}{Gold}Gold-worth of the valuables your party looted from this encounter (rounded down).

~Spiritually Aligned~.Effect: You are immune to being Silenced, Deafened and Cursed, and have +2 in Mental Resilience.
~Spiritually Aligned~.Notes:
A Deafened Unit's next Ability costs +1 Action Point.
A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.

~Fated~.Effect:
At the start of each Combat, a random Enemy gets a ~Combo~.
You have +2 in Luck.

~Genes of Olden Roots~.Effect: You gain +0.5 Initiative and you are immune to Exhaustion from lack of sleep.
~Genes of Olden Roots~.Notes: An Exhausted* Unit has -1 Action Point for each tier of Exhaustion. At Triple-Exhausted, the Unit dies.

~Diversity and Inclusion~.Effect: You get -1 Max Health. Choose a Race Talent from any other Race.

Combat Extras: When rolling equals, something weird might happen
~Augmented~.Effect:
You have +2 Max Health and +1 Health Regen, but -1 Presence.
When rolling equals on a Check, something slightly good or bad might happen to your body. The higher the roll, the better.

Combat Extras: Before a Check, you can take the average with -1.
~Human Vigilence~.Effect: Whenever you make a Roll of any kind, instead of rolling, you can automatically set the result to the average of the dice -1.

Combat Extras: Switch any Stat on Abilities/weapons to Presence
~Ignorance Bliss~.Effect:
In weapons or Abilities, you can switch any of Focus or Presence written on it to ^Presence^.
You have -2 in Observing Detail and +2 in Mental Resilience.
